M_SWB.evidence_source: [/page/7/Text/4] The estimated latent intercept and trajectory factor means were 5.73 and 0.89, respectively (both ps < .001), indicating that the average trajectory at Time 1 comprised a rating of present LS of 5.73, an increase from past to present LS of 0.89 scale points, and an increase from present to anticipated future LS of 2.15 (i.e., 0.89 × 2.42) scale points. [/page/7/Text/8] The estimated latent intercept and trajectory means were 6.33 and 0.64 respectively (both ps < .001), indicating that the average trajectory at Time 2 comprised a rating of present LS of 6.33, an increase from past to present LS of 0.64 scale points, and an increase from present to anticipated future LS of 1.96 (i.e., 0.64 × 3.06) scale points.

SD_SWB.evidence_source: [/page/7/Text/4] Also, statistically significant variances were observed for both latent factors (1.22 and 0.17, respectively, both ps < .01), indicating that respondents differed in the intercepts and slopes of their trajectories.
